task_instance: Ran `/design-system audit` against a small sample React component library (Button + InputField components, plus a tokens.css design-token file) created in the work directory, producing the skill's specified 'Output — Audit' markdown report (summary score, naming-consistency table, token-coverage table, component-completeness table, priority actions).
evidence: Created src/tokens/tokens.css (14 design tokens) and src/components/{Button.jsx,Button.css,InputField.jsx,InputField.css} with deliberate, realistic design-system issues (hardcoded hex colors instead of tokens, off-scale px spacing/radius/font-size, inconsistent variant-prop naming between components: `variant` vs `kind`). Verified the raw facts behind every audit finding by grepping the source directly (saved to audit-commands.log): `grep -rnoE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}\b' src/components` found 5 hardcoded hex colors; `grep -rnoE '[0-9]+px' src/components/*.css` found 8 hardcoded px values not using CSS custom properties; `grep -rn 'variant\|kind =' src/components/*.jsx` confirmed the variant/kind naming inconsistency. Wrote audit-report.md following the skill's exact 'Output — Audit' template, with every table cell backed by the grep evidence above (counts match: 5 hardcoded hex, 8 hardcoded px, 1 naming inconsistency). Files produced: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__design-system@developer-sandbox/{src/tokens/tokens.css, src/components/Button.jsx, src/components/Button.css, src/components/InputField.jsx, src/components/InputField.css, audit-commands.log, audit-report.md}. No connectors (Figma/knowledge-base) were needed or used — the skill's core deliverable (an audit report analyzing a codebase for token/naming/completeness issues) is fully achievable by reading and grepping local files and writing a markdown report, which this developer sandbox supports natively.
